info.title: OpenWeb PBX Administration and Reseller API
info.description: Debian 1.0.25. Scoped keys, tenant services, calling, templates, resources and recovery. Registration and domain authority remain in API v1. Prices are manual billing quotations; no payment gateway is configured.
